annotations.title: Resolve a ticker to its CIK

description: Resolve an exchange ticker to a zero-padded SEC CIK and to the company UUID. Every other tool also takes the ticker itself, so this is needed only to learn the CIK or the UUID.

as_of_date.description: Resolve the ticker as it was assigned on this date (YYYY-MM-DD); today when omitted. A ticker reused by another company resolves to the company that held it then.

name: companies_resolve
title: Resolve a ticker to its CIK
